items.label: Features
items.value: Sidefeel jeans for women feature a wide straight leg design, exuding a fashionable casual vibe. The high rise design sculpts the waistline, while the drawstring adjust the tightness of the womens jeans, enhancing the overall stylish look

items.label: Material
items.value: Wide leg jeans woman are primarily made of cotton and polyester, ensuring comfort and breathability. The elastic denim fabric,very stretchy and soft,this allows them to move and bend with the body nicely

items.label: Match
items.value: High waisted jeans can be paired with simple t-shirts or shirts, or pairing them with a fitted top or a short jacket, match them with a pair of sneakers or casual shoes to showcase a different sense of fashion

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Drawstring jeans are suitable for various occasions, whether it's daily wear, street shopping, dates, gatherings, or even some casual office settings, they can showcase a sense of trendy and personal charm

items.label: Style
items.value: Sidefeel Zimbaplatinum Jeans blend classic denim elements with trendy baggy design, Whether you are seeking casual comfort or aiming to showcase your personal charm, you can find a style that suits you in these mom jeans

items.label: Fit tips
items.value: Baggy jeans feature a relaxed wide-leg style for a comfortable and effortless fit,suitable for various body types. To ensure a more tailored fit with your jeans selection, we will recommend referring to our size chart
